sourceDecisions.movement: Use Sonic Origins to preserve the 2D controller-to-movement example role. The on-screen motion is observable; the underlying button signal is not recorded. Control all inputs in the independently authored comparison.
sourceDecisions.jump: Use Celeste to make platform, wall and landing cues visible. Native 29.97 fps source runs at its original speed in the 60 fps delivery.
sourceDecisions.matchup: Keep Super Smash Bros. Ultimate. Use the earlier Mario–Bowser approach and attack exchange, separate from DS01's decisive hits and late exchange. No frame-data claims are inferred from the recording.

nintendo.basis: Nintendo publishes Super Smash Bros. Ultimate.
